securityProfile.description: Named security posture applied before validation. 'hardened' sets the least-privilege defaults (strictReadDefault, requireCas, snapshots on, HTTP off); explicit fields override it. 'trusted-local' (the default) keeps the permissive single-user posture.

cacheDir.description: Directory holding the derived index and caches. Everything in it is regenerable — deleting it forces a full reindex, it is never the source of truth.

id.description: Stable identifier for this vault. Tools take it as their `vault` argument.

name.description: Human-readable display name. Defaults to the id when absent.

path.description: Absolute path to the vault directory on disk.

kind.description: Isolation kind, enforced one-directionally: the read:docs tools (knowledge_search/knowledge_get_critical) refuse any vault whose kind is not `docs`. `private` (default) = personal vault; `docs` = external docs corpus the read:docs surface is bound to; `system` = reserved internal vault. Not yet enforced: the private read:notes tools are NOT fenced out of a docs/system vault (a follow-up).

acl.description: Per-vault ACL override, same shape as the root `acl` block. Absent means the root ACL is inherited.

readOnly.description: Reject every mutating operation on this vault regardless of the scopes a caller holds.

defaultScopes.description: Scopes REQUIRED to operate on a path that matches no rule (P1.4). Empty (the default) adds no requirement.

rules.description: Ordered glob-to-required-scope rules enforced at dispatch (P1.4). Later matches override earlier ones.

glob.description: Glob matched against the vault-relative note path.

scopes.description: Scopes REQUIRED to operate on paths matching this rule (P1.4): a caller must hold every listed scope, in addition to the tool's own required scopes, to read/write/delete a matching path. The LAST matching rule wins, replacing rather than merging the scopes of earlier matches. An empty list adds no requirement. Enforced at dispatch on tool operations; it does not filter search/enumeration result visibility, which is governed by readPaths.

readPaths.description: Glob whitelist for reads: a path must match at least one entry. Omitted leaves reads unrestricted (see strictReadDefault).

writePaths.description: Glob whitelist for writes: a path must match at least one entry. Omitted leaves writes unrestricted.

deletePaths.description: Glob whitelist for deletes: a path must match at least one entry. Omitted leaves deletes unrestricted.

strictReadDefault.description: When true, an UNDEFINED readPaths whitelist fails CLOSED on the request path rather than only on bridge enumeration. Default false preserves allow-all back-compatibility.

restApiUrl.description: Base URL of this vault's Obsidian Local REST API, used for live-mode bridge calls.

restApiKey.description: Bearer token for the Local REST API. Secret — never logged or echoed in a tool result.

mode.description: How this vault is reached. `auto` (the default when absent) probes the Local REST API once at startup: reachable means live, otherwise headless direct-filesystem access with Tier-3 action tools degrading to requires_live_obsidian. `live`/`headless` force the mode and skip the probe.

bridges.description: Per-vault plugin-bridge timeouts. Absent uses the documented defaults.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in ms for a general plugin-bridge call to this vault's Local REST API.

probeTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in ms for the startup plugin/liveness probe. Deliberately short: it runs before the server is useful, so a dead Obsidian must not stall boot.

ocrTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in ms for an OCR bridge call, which is far slower than a normal request.

templaterTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in ms for a Templater bridge call, which may run arbitrary user template logic.

plugins.description: Per-vault plugin probe overrides, for forcing a plugin present/absent or skipping the probe.

forceEnabled.description: Plugin ids to treat as installed and enabled regardless of what the probe finds.

forceDisabled.description: Plugin ids to treat as missing regardless of what the probe finds.

probeSkip.description: Skip the startup plugin probe entirely, making forceEnabled/forceDisabled the sole source of truth. The seam CI uses to assert tool behaviour without a live Obsidian.

commands.description: Per-vault command-palette execution policy. Absent means command execution is disabled.

enabled.description: Allow execute_command on this vault at all. Deny-by-default: command execution stays off unless this is explicitly true.

allowlist.description: Command ids that may be fired when enabled. Only ids listed here run, and only with a HITL token — there is no wildcard.

folder.description: Vault folder where create_entity(materialize) writes the regenerable .md projection. A normal folder so the [[link]] graph resolves in Obsidian; SQLite remains the source of truth.

traceFolder.description: Vault-relative folder for append-only JSONL session traces. Defaults to a dot-folder so traces stay out of Obsidian's graph view.

vaults.description: Vaults this server serves. At least one is required.

plur.description: plur engram-store read proxy. Global rather than per-vault, since the plur store is global.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the plur read API. When absent (and no `command` is set) the plur tools degrade to plugin_missing with NO network call.

apiKey.description: Bearer token for the plur read API. Secret — placed only in the Authorization header, never logged or included in an error or audit payload.

apiPrefix.description: Path prefix prepended to plur API routes.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in ms for a plur read call.

command.description: argv prefix for shelling out to a local plur CLI instead of the HTTP endpoint, e.g. ["plur"]. Takes precedence over `endpoint`.

mode.description: Authentication mode. `none` grants every request full wildcard scopes and is refused on a non-loopback HTTP bind; `jwt` requires a jwtSecret or a JWKS.

jwtSecret.description: Shared secret for HS256 verification, minimum 32 characters. Secret. HS256 tokens verify ONLY against this, never against the JWKS.

tokenTtlSeconds.description: Maximum accepted token AGE in seconds, measured from the token's `iat`. This caps age INDEPENDENTLY of `exp`: a token with a one-year expiry is still rejected once it is older than this, so a long-lived credential needs this raised to match.

jwks.description: Inline JWKS document for asymmetric verification (RS256/ES256/EdDSA). Rotation is multiple keys in the set, selected by the token's `kid`.

jwksFile.description: Path to a JWKS document, loaded once at transport boot. File or inline only — no URL fetch, so verification adds no network attack surface.

algorithms.description: Explicit allowlist of accepted JWT algorithms. Algorithm confusion is structurally impossible regardless: HS256 verifies only against jwtSecret and asymmetric algorithms only against the JWKS.

audience.description: Expected `aud` claim. Binding it rejects a token an issuer minted for a DIFFERENT service (confused deputy). Required with a JWKS or a non-loopback bind; defaults to `resource` when Protected Resource Metadata is configured.

issuer.description: Expected `iss` claim. Setting it also requires an audience — validating the issuer alone does not establish that the token was meant for this server.

resource.description: This server's canonical resource URI (RFC 9728). Set together with authorizationServers to advertise Protected Resource Metadata; also serves as the default bound audience.

authorizationServers.description: Authorization server issuer URLs advertised in the Protected Resource Metadata document. At least one is needed for PRM to be served.

resourceName.description: Human-readable resource name published in the Protected Resource Metadata document.

scopesSupported.description: Scopes advertised as supported in the Protected Resource Metadata document.

acl.description: Default path ACL, inherited by any vault without its own.

readOnly.description: Reject every mutating operation on this vault regardless of the scopes a caller holds.

defaultScopes.description: Scopes REQUIRED to operate on a path that matches no rule (P1.4). Empty (the default) adds no requirement.

rules.description: Ordered glob-to-required-scope rules enforced at dispatch (P1.4). Later matches override earlier ones.

glob.description: Glob matched against the vault-relative note path.

scopes.description: Scopes REQUIRED to operate on paths matching this rule (P1.4): a caller must hold every listed scope, in addition to the tool's own required scopes, to read/write/delete a matching path. The LAST matching rule wins, replacing rather than merging the scopes of earlier matches. An empty list adds no requirement. Enforced at dispatch on tool operations; it does not filter search/enumeration result visibility, which is governed by readPaths.

readPaths.description: Glob whitelist for reads: a path must match at least one entry. Omitted leaves reads unrestricted (see strictReadDefault).

writePaths.description: Glob whitelist for writes: a path must match at least one entry. Omitted leaves writes unrestricted.

deletePaths.description: Glob whitelist for deletes: a path must match at least one entry. Omitted leaves deletes unrestricted.

strictReadDefault.description: When true, an UNDEFINED readPaths whitelist fails CLOSED on the request path rather than only on bridge enumeration. Default false preserves allow-all back-compatibility.

provider.description: Embeddings backend. `model-tier` splits dense and multi-vector across two services.

model.description: Embedding model name as the provider names it.

dimensions.description: Stored vector width, and the width of the vec0 column. Changing it requires a fresh index — existing vectors are not re-projected.

baseUrl.description: Provider base URL. Required for self-hosted runners; hosted providers default to their public API.

apiKey.description: Provider API key. Secret — never logged or returned by a tool.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in ms for a single embed request. Defaults high because local runners are far slower than hosted APIs.

maxBatchTokens.description: Estimated-token ceiling per request (chars/4), splitting a dense sub-batch before it overruns a local runner's budget. Must stay UNDER the provider's loaded context: Ollama defaults to n_ctx 4096 and rejects an over-budget request, and the chars/4 estimate undercounts real tokenization on link-dense markdown.

concurrency.description: How many embed requests run in flight at once.

truncate.description: Matryoshka (MRL) truncation: accept a provider vector WIDER than `dimensions` by keeping the first `dimensions` components and renormalising. Off by default so a non-MRL width mismatch errors instead of silently storing a meaningless prefix.

chunkContext.description: Embed and BM25-index each chunk as "{title}{ — heading breadcrumb}\n\n{content}" rather than bare section text, so title- and heading-only evidence is visible to both retrieval streams. Displayed content stays raw. The chunk hash covers the enriched text, so changing this re-embeds the vault on the next reconcile.

queryPrefix.description: Instruct prefix prepended to query-side embeds, for models whose cards require one. Empty by default — such prefixes measured harmful on this corpus.

documentPrefix.description: Instruct prefix prepended to document-side (indexing) embeds. Empty by default. Changing it re-embeds nothing on its own, since hashes cover chunk text and not the prefix — pair a change with a fresh cacheDir.

modelTier.description: Polyglot model tier: dense retrieval from one service and sparse/ColBERT from another, fused by RRF on ranks. Required when provider is model-tier.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the dense (Qwen3 via Rust TEI) embedding service.

model.description: Dense model id. Its width is what embeddings.dimensions must match.

revision.description: Pinned model revision for the dense service.

pooling.description: Pooling strategy for the dense model.

dense.description: Dense retrieval half of the model tier. Required when provider is model-tier.

full.description: Sparse and ColBERT half of the model tier. Absent disables the retrieval.sparse and retrieval.colbert streams.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the multi-vector (BGE-M3) service.

revision.description: Pinned model revision for the multi-vector service.

authToken.description: Bearer token for the multi-vector service. Secret.

dimensions.description: Dense width of the multi-vector model, separate from embeddings.dimensions.

writeConcurrency.description: Ceiling on concurrent index/embed calls across ALL vaults.

writeConcurrencyPerVault.description: Ceiling on concurrent index/embed calls for a single vault.

queueMax.description: Soft cap on distinct pending paths, surfaced as backpressure in server_health. Writes are never dropped when it is exceeded.

streamingWalk.description: Walk the vault lazily per-directory (walkVaultStream) instead of materializing the full sorted file list before indexing starts. Lower peak memory on large vaults; index output is unchanged either way.

rrfK.description: Reciprocal-rank-fusion constant for graph_rrf. Keep BELOW the stream pool size (~30): a larger k lets overlapping low-rank noise outrank confident single-stream hits.

classRouter.description: Enable the deterministic query-class router: a temporal auto-stream and a lexical short-circuit that skips the embedding round-trip. Ships dark pending an A/B on the golden set.

sparse.description: Fuse a bge-m3 learned-sparse stream into RRF at serve time. A no-op unless the embeddings provider emits the multi-vector heads (bge-m3 or model-tier).

colbert.description: Rerank the fused top-K by bge-m3 ColBERT late-interaction maxSim. A no-op unless the provider emits the multi-vector heads.

gatedRerank.description: Gate a cross-encoder rerank of the fused top-K onto hard queries only (weak top-1 seed, router silent). A no-op without a configured reranker (model-tier BGE or the gateway /rerank passthrough).

densify.description: Graph densification: derived edges added beyond the literal wikilink layer to reach multi-hop targets whose bridge notes are not explicitly linked. All off by default.

maxTagFanout.description: A tag applied to more notes than this is treated as a hub rather than a signal and emits no edges.

knnEdges.description: Emit vec0 kNN semantic-neighbour edges (edge_type similar_to).

knnK.description: Number of neighbours per note when knnEdges is enabled.

knnMinSim.description: Drop kNN edges below this cosine similarity. 0 keeps every neighbour the kNN returns.

includeInWalk.description: Let the graph walk traverse derived edges, down-weighted against authored links.

derivedWeight.description: Down-weight factor applied to expansion reached via a derived edge. Annotates the score rather than gating the edge.

llmEdges.description: Build LLM-inferred semantic edges (semantically_similar_to) via the configured gateway. Batch-only, and it sends note content to the model — local by default.

confidenceFloor.description: Minimum discrete-rubric confidence required to keep an LLM-inferred edge.

adaptiveRrf.description: Adaptive per-stream RRF weighting (THE-391): tilts dense vs lexical/sparse stream weight by per-query lexical specificity. Off by default.

enabled.description: Enable the adaptive per-stream RRF weighting tilt. Off by default.

gain.description: Strength of the tilt, clamped to [0,1] so stream weights stay within [0,2] — an over-unity gain would drive a weight negative and invert its ranking rather than just reweight it.

cache.description: THE-497 in-process query-product cache. Off by default; a hit requires the same caller, query, vault generation and retrieval configuration.

enabled.description: Cache query encodings and graph-search results in process, keyed by vault generation + caller ACL fingerprint + query + retrieval config. A latency optimisation only; off by default.

maxEntries.description: Maximum live entries per cache (results and query encodings are counted separately). Results carry chunk content, so this is the memory bound.

ttlSeconds.description: Entry lifetime. Bounds staleness from inputs the key cannot see: wall-clock recency decay, and derived state (densified edges, activation scores) written by jobs that do not bump the vault generation.

metadataPrior.description: Frontmatter metadata prior (authority boost) applied post-fusion in graph_search.

enabled.description: Apply the frontmatter authority-boost overlay after fusion.

rules.description: Field/value/boost rules summed for each result before the list is re-sorted.

field.description: Frontmatter field name to test on a candidate note.

value.description: Value that frontmatter[field] must equal for the boost to apply.

boost.description: Amount added to the fused score on a match. May be negative, which makes the rule an archive-style penalty.

clampFraction.description: Cap the absolute total boost per result at this fraction of the observed fused-score spread. Below 1 this guarantees the prior stays a tie-break: a fully boosted bottom result still cannot overtake the top base-scored one.

logRetrievals.description: Append serve-path retrieval events (chunk id, rank, score, query text, surface) to experiential.db. Local-only telemetry feeding activation recompute and usage stats; eval runs never log.

captureEpisodes.description: Record every dispatch outcome as an agent_episodes row — tool, status, duration, sizes, hashes, attribution. No payloads are stored.

captureContent.description: Also persist each episode's raw parsed arguments, secret-scanned and size-capped. Off until the poisoning defence lands: this is the write-side of the gate.

activationRerank.description: Build the ACT-R cached-activation-score lookup and thread it to every M7 graphSearch call. NOT YET WIRED to the serve-path bubble pass (bubble_safe_rerank) — that requires opts.bubbleSafe.enabled, which nothing under src/ sets, so enabling this flag currently changes no ranking. See THE-424 for the (deliberately deferred) wiring decision.

host.description: Bind address. A non-loopback host is refused while auth.mode is `none`, since every request would otherwise resolve to full wildcard scopes.

port.description: TCP port for the HTTP transport.

enableDnsRebindingProtection.description: Reject a request whose Host is neither loopback nor operator-allowed, or whose Origin is neither same-origin nor operator-allowed. Server-to-server clients send no Origin and are unaffected.

allowedHosts.description: Additional Host header values accepted by the rebinding guard.

allowedOrigins.description: Additional Origin header values accepted by the rebinding guard.

maxResponseBytes.description: Ceiling on a single tool or resource response in bytes, before it is refused (THE-514: resources/read honors this too, not just tools).

regexTimeoutMs.description: Worker-time budget in ms for one regex search. Only regex execution counts — file I/O does not — so a benign pattern over a large vault cannot false-positive the ReDoS guard.

requireCas.description: Require a prev_hash (compare-and-swap) on overwriting writes and on appends to an existing note, failing closed with invalid_input when absent so a stale hash cannot silently clobber.

toolVisibility.description: Static tool-surface scoping. Absent means allow all.

allowed.description: Name allowlist: only these tools are listed. Absent lists all; an empty array lists none.

hidden.description: Tool names dropped from tools/list but still callable by name. A leaner default surface, NOT a security boundary.

disabled.description: Tool names dropped from tools/list AND rejected at dispatch, so they behave as if unregistered.

hiddenTags.description: Tags whose tools are hidden from tools/list but remain callable.

disabledTags.description: Tags whose tools are hidden and rejected at dispatch.

requireReadOnly.description: List only non-mutating tools. Mutation is derived from each tool's required scopes, so no per-tool annotation is needed. Hides rather than rejects.

mode.description: Which surface tools/list advertises: `triad` exposes three meta-tools (find/describe/call_capability), `domain` about a dozen domain meta-tools, `flat` the full tool surface. Every registered tool stays callable by name in every mode.

deepPaths.description: Context notes loaded additionally in deep mode.

domains.description: Signal-to-path routing table. Empty means the tool degrades to lightweight with nothing to load.

signals.description: Lowercased substrings; the domain matches when any one appears in the opening message.

paths.description: Context notes loaded when this domain matches.

maxPaths.description: Ceiling on how many context notes one bootstrap may read.

default: what should i be working on
deepPhrases.description: Catch-up phrases that force deep mode regardless of the triage result.

throttle.description: Per-scope-class rate limits and write concurrency.

perMinute.description: Sustained read-scope calls allowed per minute.

burst.description: Bucket depth for read-scope calls: how many may fire back-to-back before the per-minute rate applies.

perMinute.description: Sustained write-scope calls allowed per minute.

burst.description: Bucket depth for write-scope calls: how many may fire back-to-back before the per-minute rate applies.

perMinute.description: Sustained delete-scope calls allowed per minute.

burst.description: Bucket depth for delete-scope calls: how many may fire back-to-back before the per-minute rate applies.

perMinute.description: Sustained bulk-scope calls allowed per minute.

burst.description: Bucket depth for bulk-scope calls: how many may fire back-to-back before the per-minute rate applies.

perMinute.description: Sustained execute-scope calls allowed per minute.

burst.description: Bucket depth for execute-scope calls: how many may fire back-to-back before the per-minute rate applies.

perMinute.description: Sustained admin-scope calls allowed per minute.

burst.description: Bucket depth for admin-scope calls: how many may fire back-to-back before the per-minute rate applies.

maxConcurrentWritesPerVault.description: Ceiling on concurrent write operations against a single vault.

endpoint.description: OTLP collector endpoint. OpenTelemetry export is a no-op until this is set.

headers.description: Extra headers sent with OTLP exports, e.g. an auth token. Values may be secret.

port.description: Port for the Prometheus scrape endpoint.

bind.description: Bind address for the scrape endpoint. Loopback by default — /metrics is unauthenticated.

spool.description: Write CloudEvents to a local JSONL spool file.

httpEndpoint.description: Push CloudEvents to this URL. Absent means spool-only, with no network calls.

httpHeaders.description: Extra headers sent with event pushes. Values may be secret.

retention.description: Retention policy for locally stored observability data.

eventLogDays.description: Days of event_log rows kept by the maintenance sweep. The morgiana event spool is still not pruned and grows without bound.

tracesDays.description: Days of workspace session trace files (<vault>/<traceFolder>/*.jsonl) kept by the maintenance sweep. Traces are per-vault and live INSIDE the vault, so they are also picked up by whatever syncs or backs it up. Orphans from a failed start_session are pruned by the same age rule (THE-572 writes the trace before the session row, so a failed attempt leaves a file with no row referencing it).

enabled.description: Run the periodic cache.db maintenance sweep (expired idempotency and elicitation rows, event_log retention, PRAGMA optimize).

jobsCompleteRetentionDays.description: Days a COMPLETE job row is retained before the maintenance sweep prunes it. Must stay LONGER than the longest producer dedup window: enqueue() dedups against a terminal row unless replaceIfTerminal is set, so pruning one frees its idempotency key and lets that period run again (the weekly synthesis is the longest today).

episodesRetentionDays.description: Days a DEAD agent_episodes row (a forget tombstone, or one whose valid_until has passed) is retained before the maintenance sweep prunes it. Live episodes are never pruned at any age. Keep this long enough to still answer 'was this forgotten?' after the fact.

retrievalsRetentionDays.description: Days a chunk_retrievals row is retained. NOT purely disk hygiene: chunk_access_stats is a VIEW over this table, so pruning REWRITES access_count / last_accessed_at / citations / outcome_balance, which feed activation and note quality. A short window makes a long-tail note that was genuinely useful look never-accessed. The default is deliberately a year, far above the other retention windows, so no signal any current consumer reads is affected.

jobsFailedRetentionDays.description: Days a FAILED (dead-lettered) job row is retained. Longer than the complete-row window because these exist to be read; bounded by age, so a burst of failures inside the window is still unbounded in count.

watch.description: Filesystem watch that reindexes notes changed outside.

enabled.description: Watch each vault root and reindex notes changed outside the server (sync clients, git pull, an editor on the host). Not active on Windows regardless of this setting: Node's recursive fs.watch terminated the test process there, and whether a long-lived server is affected the same way is unverified. Turn OFF for a vault on a filesystem with no usable change notification (some network mounts) or to cap inotify usage on a very large vault; index_vault then remains the only way changes are picked up.

debounceMs.description: Quiet period before a burst of filesystem events is flushed. One editor save emits several events and a sync pass emits one per file; this coalesces both into a single reindex per path. Raising it delays pickup, lowering it costs redundant reindex passes during a large sync.

enabled.description: Capture the prior content-addressed state before a destructive note write, so restore_note can roll back.

retention.description: Maximum snapshot versions kept per note. Older versions are pruned.

enabled.description: Run ambient sleep-time consolidation (synthesis and audit jobs). Only meaningful when the inference gateway roles are configured.

idempotencyTtlSeconds.description: Seconds an idempotency record is retained, bounding how long a repeated request key is deduplicated.

idempotencyReclaimSeconds.description: Seconds after which a crashed in-flight idempotency row may be reclaimed at dispatch. Raise it for legitimately slow bulk tools: setting it below a live tool's runtime risks executing that tool twice.

elicitTtlSeconds.description: Seconds a pending elicitation (human-in-the-loop prompt) stays valid before it expires.

title: obsidian-tc server config
description: Configuration for obsidian-tc. Generated from packages/shared/src/config.schema.ts — do not edit by hand. Add `"$schema": "./obsidian-tc.config.schema.json"` to your config for editor autocomplete.
